roleZh: 承载组件、扩散热量，并连接外部冷却界面。
roleEn: Supports the assembly, spreads heat and interfaces to external cooling.
featuresZh: 厚度与平面度影响热阻和装配；该模型不包含冷却液或流道仿真。
featuresEn: Thickness and flatness affect thermal resistance and assembly. This model contains no coolant or flow simulation.
materialZh: 铜；亦有其他复合底板方案。
materialEn: Copper; composite baseplate alternatives also exist.
